description: Finds people on X this brand's audience already listens to (favouring people who post clips: podcasts, interviews, talks), each checked against the live X account lookup (confirmed). Excludes people already pinned. Saves nothing — the user picks who to pin. Cost: the user's FIRST suggest is free (plan.free_suggest_available), then 50 credits per call — tell the user the cost and get a yes before a paid call. Then pass the picked handles to find_quote_moments.

space_id.description: The content space (brand) to run it on — from list_content_spaces. No space yet? setup_content_space first.

topic.description: Narrow to a topic the audience cares about, e.g. 'B2B onboarding'.

name: suggest_quote_people
title: Suggest people the audience already trusts
